article.title: Mexico’s investment in the United States
article.excerpt: No, I am not referring to immigration. The net flow of immigrants is negative, but capital investment is rising: Cemex , the Mexican cement and building materials manufacturer , is now the largest producer in its segment in the US – commanding 10.5 per cent of a highly fragmented market.
